authorization: Owner retained PR19 for future OpenBench and requested one next substantial idea from current champion PR18 with the same correctness and VSTC/STC/LTC gates.
hypothesis: Add all legal non-capture-stage checking moves after inherited TT/captures at the first points qsearch ply. Unlike fatal non-pawn captures, quiet checks retain the attacker and may expose checks and mates beyond the capture horizon.

fixed_policy.ordering: Existing TT/capture order preserved; added checks in legal generator order; no duplicate TT move
fixed_policy.promotion: Existing capture-stage queen promotions retained; quiet checking underpromotions are eligible
fixed_policy.tt_depth: Points entry0; recursive-1; shallow bounds cannot cut off or replace the static value of the richer entry search; legacy0 unchanged
fixed_policy.tt_move: Inherited legal TT move remains first, including quiet moves; the new explicit generation allowance does not remove inherited TT continuations

risk: Extra branches may cost more than tactical gains. One explicit layer is fixed before build/results; no strength-driven tuning. Mate is settled by existing earned points, so mating may win, draw or lose.
unchanged: SEE including all captures; PR19 pruning excluded
compiler: GCC16.1 MinGW BMI2 LTO no PGO
